message.content:
SELECT b.brand_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pbm.product_id) AS current_product_count,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales_without_freight
FROM brands b
LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pbm
  ON pbm.brand_id = b.brand_id
 AND pbm.is_current = true
LEFT JOIN order_items oi
  ON oi.product_id = pbm.product_id
GROUP BY b.brand_id
ORDER BY b.brand_id
LIMIT ALL;
